snippet.title: Cozy Holiday – Announcement Trailer (Coming VERY SOON!!)
snippet.description:
Hello Guys. 

In the middle of our fast-paced everyday work, we paused to build something softer. Its Cozy Holiday, a relaxing co-op game for two players. Discover winter wonderlands, deliver gifts, and enjoy the moments with your friends. 
We hope you’ll like our new game and enjoy your time with it.

SteamPage: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134110/Cozy_Holiday/

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/VQqrmTAh4n  
Join our X: https://x.com/Centurion_Dev
Join our Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CenturionDevelopments
